BATTLE-SPIRITS-A8498.name: The ArmoredBushin Girafa-Rando
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A8498.effect:
[LV1][LV2] Purple/White/Blue (Opposing Turn)
When the opponent uses a Purple/White/Blue Magic effect, by exhausting this Spirit, negate that effect.

[LV1][LV2] (Opposing Attack Step)
This Spirit can block opposing Spirits while exhausted.

[LV2] (When Attacks)
When only the opposing Spirit is destroyed by comparing BP, refresh this Spirit and exhaust an opposing Spirit.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A9393.name: The DinoDeity Gundinos
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A9393.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] [Assault: 2] (When Attacks)
This Spirit can, up to twice per turn, be refreshed by exhausting one of your Nexuses.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
Destroy an opposing 5000 BP or less Spirit. When this effect destroys any opposing Spirit, draw a card.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A10742.name: The HellWheel Buer
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A10742.effect:
[Brave Condition: Cost 4 or more]

[When Braved] (When Brave Attacks)
Draw a card, and send a core from any opposing Cost 4 or less Spirit to their Reserve.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A13620.name: The WingBeast Griffi-Oar
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A13620.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
Return every Yellow Magic card from your Trash to the Hand.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
You can use your Magic cards without paying the cost during the Flash Timing.
